content.title: The “La Ilaha Illallah” Campaign — A Glorious Journey of 50 Million+ Dhikr Worldwide
content.subtitle: Join the Worldwide Testimony to the Oneness of Our Lord
content.body:
It feels like only yesterday that we launched our Durood and Istighfar campaign. Our goal was to recite them at least 10 million times in 10 days. But through your enthusiastic participation, Allah Subhanahu wa Ta'ala made what seemed impossible easy. We crossed that milestone well before the deadline. By the end of the 10 days, each count had reached nearly 15 million! You may have recited even more beyond what was recorded—Allahumma Barik!

With that same momentum and renewed enthusiasm, we have now embarked on another glorious journey. Welcome to this blessed campaign to spread “La Ilaha Illallah”—the foundation of Islam, the weightiest words in the heavens and earth, and the key to Jannah—across the world.

Why Is “La Ilaha Illallah” a Believer’s Greatest Treasure?

1. Words Heavier Than the Heavens and Earth on the Scales

The Messenger of Allah ﷺ narrated that Musa (AS) asked Allah, “My Lord, teach me something with which I can remember and call upon You.” Allah said, “O Musa, say: La Ilaha Illallah.” Musa (AS) replied, “My Lord, all Your servants say this.” Allah then said:

“O Musa, if the seven heavens and everything within them, along with the seven earths, were placed on one side of the scale, and La Ilaha Illallah on the other, La Ilaha Illallah would outweigh them.”

— (Sahih Ibn Hibban: 6218; Mustadrak al-Hakim: 1985)

2. The Best Dhikr and the Glad Tidings of Jannah

The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, “The best dhikr is La Ilaha Illallah, and the best supplication is Alhamdulillah.”

— (Jami‘ at-Tirmidhi: 3383)

In another narration, the Prophet ﷺ gave this glad tiding: “Whoever’s final words are La Ilaha Illallah will enter Jannah.”

— (Sunan Abi Dawud: 3116)

3. A Way to Renew Your Faith

Our hearts are constantly clouded by sins, worries, and worldly attachments. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ told his Companions, “Renew your faith.” They asked, “O Messenger of Allah, how can we renew our faith?” He replied, “Recite La Ilaha Illallah frequently.”

— (Musnad Ahmad: 8710)

50 Million in 15 Days: Not a Numbers Game, but a Sincere Effort to Please Our Lord

Yes, our goal is ambitious this time: to recite “La Ilaha Illallah” at least 50 million times worldwide through our app over the next 15 days.

The number may seem enormous on paper, but when millions of believing hearts are ready to testify to the Oneness of their Lord, no goal is beyond reach.

Through this campaign, we want the sacred words of Tawheed to resonate in homes everywhere. On the way to work, while doing household chores, during moments of leisure, or in the stillness of the night, may our tongues and hearts never be separated from this Kalimah. Your 10, 100, or 1,000 recitations will all contribute toward completing this noble goal of 50 million, In Sha Allah.

footer_button.hint: Let us dedicate the life and tongues Allah has given us to proclaiming His greatness. Recite it yourself, and invite your family members and friends to join this blessed effort.
